subject: Physics
description: KE, PE, mechanical, thermal, chemical, nuclear; conservation of energy

questions.stem: KINETIC ENERGY of a body of mass m moving at velocity v is:
questions.explanation: KE = (1/2)mv². DEPENDENCE ON v²: doubling speed quadruples KE. UNIT: Joules (J = kg·m²/s²). INSIGHT — at HIGH speeds (relativistic, near speed of light), this formula breaks down. Einstein's relativity: KE = (γ−1)mc² where γ = 1/√(1−v²/c²). For v << c, reduces to (1/2)mv². EXAMPLE: car at 60 km/h (~17 m/s), mass 1000 kg → KE = (1/2)(1000)(17²) = 144,500 J = ~145 kJ. Same car at 120 km/h → 4× KE = 580 kJ. This is why ROAD ACCIDENTS are far worse at high speeds (energy quadruples; damage scales). KE is RELATIVE — depends on reference frame (passenger has zero KE relative to car, high KE relative to road).

questions.stem: POTENTIAL ENERGY of a body of mass m at HEIGHT h is:
questions.explanation: GRAVITATIONAL PE = mgh, where g = 9.8 m/s² on Earth's surface. PE depends on REFERENCE LEVEL — if ground = 0, PE = mgh; if some other level, scales accordingly. ENERGY CONVERSION: object falls → PE → KE (mgh = (1/2)mv², so v = √(2gh) ignoring air resistance). EXAMPLE: dropping ball from 5 m → hits ground at v = √(2×9.8×5) ≈ 9.9 m/s. CONSERVATION OF MECHANICAL ENERGY: KE + PE = constant (in absence of friction). USES: hydroelectric dams (water's PE → KE → electric); pumped storage (charge by lifting water at low demand, generate when demand high). PE is also defined for: SPRINGS (PE = (1/2)kx²); chemical bonds (chemical PE — fuels, batteries); nuclear (mass-energy).

questions.stem: Law of CONSERVATION OF ENERGY states that:

options.option_text: Energy can be transformed but NOT created or destroyed
Energy can be created from nothing in special cases
Energy disappears in friction always (option here)
Energy is constant only in vacuum (option here)

questions.explanation: CONSERVATION OF ENERGY (1st Law of Thermodynamics) — total energy of an ISOLATED system is CONSTANT. Energy can convert between forms but cannot be created or destroyed. APPLICATIONS: friction → KE → heat; rolling ball → KE → sound + heat (eventually stops); battery → electrical → light + heat (LED). Doesn't violate when energy 'disappears' — it just transformed (often to heat). EINSTEIN'S extension: mass + energy interchangeable (E = mc²). NUCLEAR reactions convert tiny mass to huge energy (matter NOT conserved separately; mass-energy is). PERPETUAL MOTION machines violate this — many proposed historically; all proven impossible. PHYSICS' MOST FUNDAMENTAL law (along with momentum conservation). NOETHER's THEOREM: energy conservation = consequence of TIME translation symmetry (laws of physics are same at all times).

options.option_text: Stretching a rubber band only here

questions.explanation: CHEMICAL ENERGY — stored in BONDS between atoms in molecules. RELEASED via: COMBUSTION (fuel burns → CO₂ + H₂O + heat); BATTERIES (electrochemical reactions); FOOD METABOLISM (cellular respiration: glucose + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O + ATP); EXPLOSIVES (TNT, dynamite — rapid chemical release). FOSSIL FUELS = stored solar energy (millions of years ago, plants captured sun energy via photosynthesis; later compressed → coal/oil/gas). FOOD CALORIES (kcal) = chemical energy per unit mass. INSIGHT — chemical PE is electrical PE between atoms (electron arrangements). NUCLEAR energy = much more concentrated (~million× chemical) — bonds within nucleus, not between atoms.

questions.stem: RENEWABLE energy sources include all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: RENEWABLE — replenished naturally on human timescales: SOLAR (PV cells, solar thermal); WIND; HYDRO (rivers, dams); BIOMASS (plant matter, biofuels); GEOTHERMAL (Earth's heat); TIDAL + WAVE; HYDROGEN (if produced by renewable electricity). NON-RENEWABLE: COAL, OIL, NATURAL GAS, NUCLEAR (Uranium-235 finite). India's renewable goal: 500 GW by 2030 (already 175+ GW). India world's #4 in installed RENEWABLE capacity. INSIGHT — even 'renewable' has caveats: solar panels need rare metals; wind farms affect bird migration; hydro displaces communities; biofuels can compete with food crops. CLEAN energy transition is complex; mix of sources + storage (batteries, pumped hydro) needed.

questions.explanation: FOOD calorie = LARGE / KILOcalorie (kcal) = 1000 small calories = 4184 J. Often ambiguously written 'calorie' on labels. SCIENTIFIC CALORIE (small) = energy to raise 1g of water by 1°C = 4.184 J. Daily energy intake: ~2000 kcal/day for women, ~2500 kcal/day for men. CALORIES BURNED: walking 1 hr ~250 kcal; jogging 1 hr ~500-700; sleeping 1 hr ~50. ENERGY CONTENT (kcal/g): CARBS 4, PROTEIN 4, FAT 9, ALCOHOL 7. UNITS: J (SI), cal, kcal, kJ, BTU (British Thermal Unit), kWh. CONVERSIONS: 1 kcal = 4184 J; 1 kJ = 0.239 kcal; 1 kWh = 3600 kJ = 860 kcal; 1 BTU = 1.055 kJ.

questions.stem: An object thrown vertically up from earth: at HIGHEST POINT, its:

options.option_text: KE is zero, PE is maximum
KE is maximum, PE is zero
Both KE and PE are zero

questions.explanation: AT highest point: velocity = 0 → KE = (1/2)mv² = 0. Height max → PE = mgh max. CONSERVATION: KE + PE = constant (initial KE at launch). At launch: all KE, no PE. At top: all PE, no KE. On way down: PE → KE again. Total energy conserved (ignore air resistance). INSIGHT — same logic for: PENDULUM (KE max at bottom of swing; PE max at extremes); DROPPED ball (PE → KE on way down); HYDRAULIC ENERGY (water at top of dam). REAL-WORLD: friction / air resistance dissipates some energy as heat → object doesn't return to original height.
